<div class="sm-hero-wrap">
  <div class="sm-hero-inner">
    <span class="sm-eyebrow">Statistics &middot; Mathematics &middot; Data Science</span>
    <h1 class="sm-title-sm"><i class="fa-solid fa-circle-info sm-hero-icon"></i> About Stat Mania</h1>
    <p class="sm-subtitle-sm">A free place to learn statistics by reading, watching, playing and experimenting</p>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="sm-section">
  <div class="sm-section-head">
    <h2><i class="fa-solid fa-lightbulb"></i>What is Stat Mania?</h2>
  </div>
  <div class="sm-about">
    <p><strong>Stat Mania</strong> is a free learning site for <strong>statistics, mathematics and data science</strong>. It started as a collection of lecture slides for college students and has grown into a small ecosystem: slides, a blog, an interactive R course, data tools, quizzes, and a growing arcade of games that sneak real probability and number sense into play.</p>
    <p>Everything runs in your browser. There is nothing to install, no account to create and nothing to pay for.</p>
    <p>The guiding idea is simple: statistics sticks when you can <strong>poke at it</strong>. So wherever possible, a concept comes with something to click, drag, simulate or play.</p>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="sm-section">
  <div class="sm-section-head">
    <h2><i class="fa-solid fa-user-pen"></i>Who makes it?</h2>
  </div>
  <div class="sm-about">
    <p>Stat Mania is written and maintained by <strong>Abdullah Al Mahmud</strong>, a lecturer in statistics at Mymensingh Girls' Cadet College, Bangladesh. Earlier he taught at Sylhet Cadet College and Pabna Cadet College, worked as a research assistant, and wrote science articles for a national daily. Writing as <em>Abdullah Adil Mahmud</em>, he has also published six popular-science books in Bangla.</p>
    <p>The slides, questions and tools are built with open tools: <strong>R</strong>, <strong>Python</strong>, <strong>Quarto</strong>, <strong>LaTeX</strong>, plain HTML and JavaScript. That is why most of it can be rebuilt from text files and why it stays fast and free.</p>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="sm-section">
  <div class="sm-section-head">
    <h2><i class="fa-solid fa-compass"></i>What's on the site</h2>
    <p>A tour of every section. Click any card to jump in.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="sm-grid">

  <a class="sm-card" href="lectures.html">
    <div class="sm-card-icon"><i class="fa-solid fa-chalkboard-user"></i></div>
    <h3>Lecture Slides</h3>
    <p>About two dozen slide decks covering probability, random variables, central tendency, dispersion, key distributions, correlation and regression, sampling, time series and more.</p>
    <span class="sm-link">Open Slides <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right"></i></span>
  </a>

  <a class="sm-card" href="blog/">
    <div class="sm-card-icon"><i class="fa-solid fa-feather"></i></div>
    <h3>Blog (English)</h3>
    <p>Fifty-odd posts on statistics, time series with R code, C for R and Python users, Linux and Git tips, and research workflow.</p>
    <span class="sm-link">Read the Blog <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right"></i></span>
  </a>

  <a class="sm-card" href="https://bnstatmania.blogspot.com/">
    <div class="sm-card-icon"><i class="fa-solid fa-language"></i></div>
    <h3>Blog (Bangla)</h3>
    <p>A companion blog in Bangla for readers who prefer to learn statistics in their own language.</p>
    <span class="sm-link">Read in Bangla <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right"></i></span>
  </a>

  <a class="sm-card" href="courses/index.html">
    <div class="sm-card-icon"><i class="fa-brands fa-r-project"></i></div>
    <h3>Courses</h3>
    <p>An interactive <strong>R Programming</strong> course: variables, vectors, control flow, functions, data frames and plotting. Every code block is live and editable, run in your browser with WebR, so there is nothing to install. Python and SQL courses are planned.</p>
    <span class="sm-link">Start Learning <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right"></i></span>
  </a>

  <a class="sm-card" href="utility/index.html">
    <div class="sm-card-icon"><i class="fa-solid fa-wrench"></i></div>
    <h3>Utility Tools</h3>
    <p>Everyday helpers: BMI calculator, age calculator, alarm clock with named alarms and snooze, strong password generator, and a timer / countdown with fullscreen support.</p>
    <span class="sm-link">Open Tools <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right"></i></span>
  </a>

  <a class="sm-card" href="games/index.html">
    <div class="sm-card-icon"><i class="fa-solid fa-gamepad"></i></div>
    <h3>Games</h3>
    <p>Fifteen quick games, from math drills and word puzzles to arcade reflex games. Several come with a score, a personal top 10, sound effects and an <em>Achievement Index</em> that shows how close you got to a perfect round.</p>
    <span class="sm-link">Play Games <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right"></i></span>
  </a>

  <a class="sm-card" href="question/stat-prob.html">
    <div class="sm-card-icon"><i class="fa-solid fa-circle-question"></i></div>
    <h3>Quizzes</h3>
    <p>A Statistics &amp; Probability quiz with math rendering, and a General Knowledge quiz for a break from numbers.</p>
    <span class="sm-link">Take a Quiz <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right"></i></span>
  </a>

  <a class="sm-card" href="ds/viz/scatter.html">
    <div class="sm-card-icon"><i class="fa-solid fa-chart-column"></i></div>
    <h3>Data Visualization</h3>
    <p>Make charts without code: bar charts, histograms, pie charts and scatter plots, a statistical data generator, a correlation visualizer, and the Aesthetic Equations gallery of beautiful mathematical curves.</p>
    <span class="sm-link">Make a Chart <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right"></i></span>
  </a>

  <a class="sm-card" href="ds/analysis/clt.html">
    <div class="sm-card-icon"><i class="fa-solid fa-flask"></i></div>
    <h3>Analysis Tools</h3>
    <p>A Central Limit Theorem visualizer, a distribution calculator and distribution visualizer, a CSV data analysis tool that gives a quick overview of your file, and a text-mining tool.</p>
    <span class="sm-link">Explore Analysis <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right"></i></span>
  </a>

  <a class="sm-card" href="ds/dash/rpkg.html">
    <div class="sm-card-icon"><i class="fa-solid fa-gauge-high"></i></div>
    <h3>R Package Dashboard</h3>
    <p>A dashboard of R package statistics, built with Quarto and R.</p>
    <span class="sm-link">Open Dashboard <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right"></i></span>
  </a>

  <a class="sm-card" href="snippets.html">
    <div class="sm-card-icon"><i class="fa-solid fa-code"></i></div>
    <h3>Code Snippets</h3>
    <p>Short, reusable snippets for the shell, R and Python that save a trip to the search engine.</p>
    <span class="sm-link">Browse Snippets <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right"></i></span>
  </a>

  <a class="sm-card" href="resources.html">
    <div class="sm-card-icon"><i class="fa-solid fa-book-bookmark"></i></div>
    <h3>Resources</h3>
    <p>Hand-picked external links (GIS, maps and more) plus on-site downloads such as a list of probability distributions with their PMF / PDF formulas.</p>
    <span class="sm-link">See Resources <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right"></i></span>
  </a>

<div class="sm-section">
  <div class="sm-section-head">
    <h2><i class="fa-solid fa-gamepad"></i>The games, at a glance</h2>
    <p>Each one is a few minutes long and runs on any device.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="sm-about-list">
    <ul>
      <li><a href="games/add-sub.html">Addition &amp; Subtraction</a>: timed two-digit arithmetic</li>
      <li><a href="games/math-challenge.html">Math Challenge</a>: 60-second rapid fire with levels</li>
      <li><a href="games/guess-number.html">Guess the Number</a>: find a secret number from 1 to 100</li>
      <li><a href="games/monty-hall.html">Monty Hall</a>: stick or switch? Watch the probability prove itself</li>
      <li><a href="games/tic-tac-toe.html">Tic-Tac-Toe</a> and <a href="games/reverse-tic-tac-toe.html">Misère Tic-Tac-Toe</a>: against a minimax AI</li>
      <li><a href="games/sudoku.html">Sudoku</a>: 4&times;4 up to 9&times;9, 50 puzzles</li>
      <li><a href="games/cross-word.html">Crossword</a>, <a href="games/wordweave.html">WordWeave</a>, <a href="games/word-ladder.html">Word Ladder</a> and <a href="games/word-search.html">Word Search</a>: word puzzles</li>
      <li><a href="games/dirt.html">Dirt Toss</a>: hit a drifting, layered target</li>
      <li><a href="games/particle-pop.html">Particle Pop</a>: pop drifting particles, smaller is worth more</li>
      <li><a href="games/hue-hunter.html">Hue Hunter</a>: pop only the color you chose</li>
      <li><a href="games/archery-drift.html">Archery Drift</a>: lead a moving target with a bow</li>
    </ul>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="sm-section">
  <div class="sm-section-head">
    <h2><i class="fa-solid fa-heart"></i>Good to know</h2>
  </div>
  <div class="sm-about">
    <p><strong>It is free and needs no sign-up.</strong> The site uses basic analytics (Google Analytics with IP anonymization) to see which pages are useful. Some games save your scores and settings, such as top 10 lists and the mute choice, in your own browser only.</p>
    <p><strong>Found a mistake or have an idea?</strong> Corrections and suggestions are welcome. You can reach the author through the links on the <a href="blog/about.html">blog's About page</a>.</p>
  </div>
</div>
